usage: llm-modelbench [-h] [--version] [--config CONFIG] [--selftest]
                      {inventory,capability-evidence,reprobe-plan,runtime-fit,doctor,runtime,plan,campaign,run,watch,report,simulate,context-profile,model-cards,freeze,serve,pack-subjective,grade,judge-dumps,repair,wizard,diff,export-review,repeat-report,sensitivity-plan,sensitivity-report,coverage,gaps,dossier,rankings,selftest} ...

Hardware-adaptive benchmark suite for local Ollama models.

positional arguments:
  {inventory,capability-evidence,reprobe-plan,runtime-fit,doctor,runtime,plan,campaign,run,watch,report,simulate,context-profile,model-cards,freeze,serve,pack-subjective,grade,judge-dumps,repair,wizard,diff,export-review,repeat-report,sensitivity-plan,sensitivity-report,coverage,gaps,dossier,rankings,selftest}
    inventory           list local models
    capability-evidence
                        read-only classification of the fleet's stored
                        capability evidence (Anvil Stage 2.7A)
    reprobe-plan        deterministic, read-only capability reprobe plan from
                        Stage 2.7A evidence classification (Anvil Stage 2.7B)
    runtime-fit         read-only conservative model-to-runtime GPU capacity
                        assessment
    doctor              preflight environment, import path, Ollama, GPU, disk
    runtime             discover and manage external local runtime profiles
    plan                show active models, skipped models, tasks, samples,
                        and rough ETA without running
    campaign            manage isolated campaign workspaces
    run                 run the benchmark
    watch               live terminal dashboard for a run
    report              rebuild reports for a run
    simulate            offline VRAM and watcher simulations
    context-profile     run one controlled 64k-class needle telemetry profile
    model-cards         generate standalone operating cards from master
                        rankings
    freeze              create a pre-release source/task/rankings regression
                        snapshot
    serve               serve read-only routing data from summary.json
                        artifacts
    pack-subjective     collate subjective outputs for grading
    grade               blind human grading workflow for subjective outputs
    judge-dumps         judge existing subjective dumps without rerunning
                        tested models
    repair              scan incomplete run evidence and apply bounded
                        targeted recovery
    wizard              interactive model + test-scope planner, capability
                        probe, review, and run
    diff                compare two run directories
    export-review       zip useful run artefacts for GPT/Claude review
    repeat-report       compare repeated runs at per-model/per-task level
    sensitivity-plan    print a diagnostic config-sensitivity sweep script
    sensitivity-report  summarise completed config-sensitivity runs
    coverage            read or update the digest-keyed coverage ledger
    gaps                advisory coverage gaps; never schedules runs
    dossier             read-only composite over covered non-stale categories
    rankings            merge every run into a persistent master database and
                        HTML model-card report
    selftest            verify scoring logic offline

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --config CONFIG       path to a JSON or YAML config file
  --selftest            run offline scorer tests and exit
